description.summary: query and observe user-level appearance settings

protocol.description:
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development. It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways, without incrementing the interface major version and without prior notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or semantics remaining stable across releases.
This protocol allows general applications to query and receive live notifications for user-level appearance settings managed by the compositor, including cursor theme and size, fonts (proportional, monospace, size), and visual appearance (icon theme, accent color, window opacity, color scheme, titlebar height, and corner radius).
Any client may bind this interface. The compositor pushes the current value of every setting immediately after the client binds this global, and broadcasts events to all bound clients whenever a setting changes.
The terms "must", "must not", "should", and "may" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

interface.name: treeland_appearance_v1
interface.description: A singleton global for observing user-level appearance settings of the current user. These settings are shared by all windows and clients of the user rather than being per-window. Each bound client receives events reporting the initial values of all settings immediately after binding, and subsequent events whenever any setting changes.

enum.name: color_scheme
enum.description:
A user-level hint for the preferred color scheme. Clients should use this value to style their self-drawn widgets and UI elements accordingly. The compositor also applies this hint to server-side decorations. This is semantically equivalent to org.freedesktop.appearance color-scheme and the CSS prefers-color-scheme media feature.
This enum mirrors treeland_appearance_manager_v1.color_scheme (in the privileged treeland-appearance-manager-unstable-v1 protocol): the entry names and values are identical and must stay in sync. Any new value must be added to both at once.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the treeland_appearance_v1 object. The compositor will no longer send events on this object after this request.

event.name: cursor_theme
event.description: Emitted by the compositor when the cursor theme changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current theme.

event.name: cursor_size
event.description: Emitted by the compositor when the cursor size changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current size in pixels. Width and height may differ on hardware that supports non-square cursor planes.

event.name: font
event.description: Emitted when the proportional font family changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current font.

event.name: monospace_font
event.description: Emitted when the monospace font family changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current font.

event.name: font_size
event.description: Emitted when the base font size changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current size in points.

event.name: icon_theme
event.description: Emitted when the icon theme changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current theme.

event.name: accent_color
event.description: Emitted when the accent color changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current color. Color components are unsigned values in the range [0, 255].

event.name: window_opacity
event.description: Emitted when the global window background opacity changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current value. The value is an integer percentage in the range [0, 100].

arg.name: opacity
arg.summary: current window background opacity as a percentage [0, 100]

event.name: color_scheme
event.description: Emitted when the color scheme hint changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current scheme. Clients should restyle their self-drawn components whenever this event is received.

event.name: titlebar_height
event.description: Emitted when the compositor titlebar height changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current value in pixels.

arg.name: height
arg.summary: current compositor titlebar height in pixels

event.name: corner_radius

description.summary: global window corner radius has changed

event.description: Emitted when the global default corner radius changes. Also emitted immediately after binding to report the current value in pixels.

arg.name: radius
arg.summary: current global corner radius in pixels
